3. [도망쳐요, 관장님!](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/gt4h0ih/) by Chul Joong
4. [바!라볼수록 보!고싶은 남자](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/l5urzub/) by Nickup
5. [YES OR NO](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/briak12/) by Uhrin
